name: lance_3b_video_mlx (video variant)
description: MLX safetensors port of ByteDance Lance video-3B weight (Lance_3B_Video/). Standalone F32 weight: shared LLM backbone + adapters + 31-frame latent position embedding + the video ViT, in one file (matching ByteDance's Lance_3B_Video layout).

source_pt.note: The video weight is the shared Lance_3B backbone plus a video supplement (31-frame latent_pos_embed overriding the 1-frame image one, and the video ViT). ByteDance ships this merged into one Lance_3B_Video/model.safetensors; we do the same.

composition: 1021 t2v keys (LLM backbone + adapters + 31-frame latent_pos_embed, shared with the image variant) + 390 vit_model keys (video ViT)

verification.supplement_byte_identical_with: RockTalk/Lance-3B-Video-MLX model_supplement.safetensors (391/391 byte-equal), which STAGE 9 cross-checked byte-clean vs the original PT supplement (390 identical + 1 patch_embed layout transpose).
verification.t2v_end_to_end: Single-step v_full/v_unc/v_blend cos = 0.999916 / 0.999848 / 0.999452 vs PT, reproducing STAGE 9. STAGE 9 also gave 30-step per-step latent cos >= 0.999 and video pixel cos = 0.999338 vs PT.
verification.honesty_note: t2v is verified end-to-end and consumes the 1021-key subset (vit_model is not used by t2v). The bundled video ViT (vit_model, 390 keys) is byte-clean vs PT. x2t_video is now implemented and re-verified non-blind in STAGE 11 (PT-recomputed patches & positions byte-identical, K=8 top-1 8/8, min logit cos 0.999437; scope: given identical resized/normalized frames and grid). video_edit is still NOT implemented. See post_release_correction.

post_release_correction.summary: Two bugs found after release and fixed: (1) ViT patch-token order (raster vs 2x2 merge-grouped), affecting x2t / image_edit / x2t_video; (2) x2t_video temporal mRoPE multiplier (tokens_per_second=2) missing, video-only. STAGE 7's PT-direct-import gates were blind: they fed PT our intermediates instead of having PT recompute from raw inputs. Re-verified non-blind in STAGE 11 (x2t_video: PT-recomputed patches & positions byte-identical, K=8 top-1 8/8, min logit cos 0.999437).
post_release_correction.note: These are MLX pipeline/harness bugs, not weight bugs. This safetensors is unchanged (SHA256 still 03399dcd...). t2v does not use the ViT and is unaffected.
